added_lines: . st. vincent de paul society the monthly collection for the local conference of the svp society will be taken up after each mass next weekend, sat 3 1 oct & sun 01 nov. rediscovering catholic customs every generation inherits traditions from the past which shape our catholic identity. they have been woven into the daily of life, complimenting the liturgical year and enriching personal piety. october and november are rich months for rediscovering catholic customs that may have faded from everyday practice. there are many graces to be received from praying for the dead. we do this at mass, at funerals, while visiting cemeteries. our dear departed are remembered in a special way on the feast of all saints (nov 1) and the day of all souls (nov 2). [based on an article by maria hall, liturgy consultant, in intercom, october 2026] holy souls’ envelopes, with lists for the names of our deceased relatives and friends, are available in boxes at the entrances to the church. if you use the parish envelope system, you will find a list in your box. please return them to the church. they will be placed in a basket before the altar and masses will be offered for the deceased during the month of november. mass intentions sat 24 oct 18:00 jim ryan (1st teresa ryan patricia deegan carol moran sun 25 oct 10:00 11:30 paschal ryan rosemary o’shea harry o’sullivan 26 oct 10:00 pro popolo tues 27 oct 10:00 eugene feeley wed 28 oct 10:00 patricia deegan (rec dec) thur 29 oct 10:00 fri 30 oct 10:00 sat 31 oct 18:00 max & kathleen norden; pauline & mitchell norden; tom byrnes sun 01 nov 10:00 11:30 kitty, seán & celine penny eva & donie finucane frank gallagher & marguerite lovett our lady of the rosary

message from úna mccarthy dear father derek and fellow parishioners, i am writing to express my heartfelt thanks for the beautiful presentation of the benemerenti medal which i received on sunday 20th september following the 12.30pm mass. i was deeply moved and honoured to receive this papal award in recognition of my service as parish clerk and sacristan. i t was a privilege to serve the parish and the wider church from 2003 until my retir ement in june 2025 due to ill health. i am so grateful for the kindness, support and f riendship shown to me by fr pat o’sullivan, fr tom mangan, fr oliver plunkett, fr liam enright and by yourself fr derek and by all of you, my fellow parishioners, throughou t those years. the warmth and thoughtfulness of the presentation meant a great deal to me and to family. to be remembered in this way by the parish community is a treasured gift, and the medal will always remind me of the special place st joseph’s holds in my heart. i give thanks to god for the opportunity to serve and for the many blessings received thr ough the life of the parish. thank you once again, fr derek, for arranging such a memorab le occasion, and thank you to everyone who joined in the celebration. your generosity and care have touched me deeply. may god bless you all. sunday 1st november, readers: 10:30am mass: nial enright 12:30pm mass: sr. martina eucharistic minister 1st november : 10:30am mass: eithne gavin 12:30pm mass: anderson vieira simply scan with your camera phone and donate to st. joseph’s thank you contact details: canon derek leonard
